title: Storm is Brewing
next_chapter_hook: While the Second Elder was still gloating over his 'perfect plan' for tomorrow, Chen Ji had already laid out a devastating chess game in the shadows that would nail him to the pillar of shame—he would use the Second Elder's own blade to sever the Second Elder's own arm.

text.content: Deep in the night, in the dense forest of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, a sword light pierced through the sky. It was a flying sword message from Second Elder Ling Yuan, the sword blade engraved with the mark of the Dark Moon Pavilion. The secret order was brief and cold: 'Tonight at midnight, at the Servants' Quarters, take Chen Ji's life. Act swiftly, leave no witnesses.' In the secret chamber, the Second Elder toyed with the Jade Slip in his hand, a cold, sinister smile curling at the corner of his mouth. This worthless disciple cannot remain.

At the same time, in the spiritual hall outside the Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji sat cross-legged as if in meditation. Yet his divine consciousness stretched dozens of zhang outward, capturing that fleeting sword light. He slowly opened his eyes, devoid of fear, only a tranquil acceptance that seemed long anticipated. A faint, sardonic curve graced his lips. 'Second Elder, you finally cannot hold back anymore?'

choice.prompt: The Second Elder's assassination order has been issued, and you have already set up an inescapable net. Now, how will you welcome this assassination?

choices.text: Lure the Tiger Out of Its Den
choices.description: Deliberately expose flaws to lure the assassins into the ambush you and Su Qingyao have meticulously prepared, eliminating them all at once.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming 10 points of Strategic Cunning to set up in advance
choices.visible_reward: Capture the assassins alive and obtain complete intelligence about the Second Elder's plan
choices.risk_hint: If the ambush is exposed, it will alert the enemy

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) Since they are coming, then they shall not leave. Since the Second Elder wants to use such disgraceful assassination methods, I shall make him fail miserably.

choices.description: Instead of waiting for the assassins, strike back with thunderous force, crushing the danger in its bud.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming 15 points of Combat Power
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the Second Elder and reveal your true strength
choices.risk_hint: May expose your actual cultivation level

dialogue.content: (His eyes turning cold) Rather than being passively beaten, I would rather take the initiative. The Second Elder wants to kill me? Then I shall let him know the consequences of provoking me.

text.content: Outside the spiritual hall, an ethereal fragrance silently drifted. Su Qingyao's figure emerged from the shadows, moonlight illuminating her cold and stunning features, casting a serene radiance. She held a longsword, its blade flowing with faint Spiritual Light, clearly a spirit artifact of not low grade. 'Is everything prepared?' Her voice was low, carrying a hint of undetectable tension. Chen Ji nodded slightly: 'Everything is ready, only waiting for the east wind. Tonight, let the Second Elder witness what it means to bite off more than one can chew.'

The night was as dark as ink, and cold winds wailed through the ruins of the Servants' Quarters. With midnight approaching, the world lay in dead silence, only the candlelight within the spiritual hall flickering unstably, casting eerie shadows in the darkness. Chen Ji sat with closed eyes, his breathing long and even, appearing on the surface no different from an ordinary Servant Disciple. Yet deep within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly—that was the foresight he had exchanged for 5 points of Heavenly Fate: within three hours, two assassins at the Nascent Soul late stage would come to take his life.

Suddenly, the air outside the spiritual hall solidified abruptly. A bone-chilling killing intent pressed down like something tangible, nearly tearing this space apart. Two black shadows swooped out from the darkness like ghosts, their speed too fast for the naked eye to track, lunging directly toward the spiritual hall. 'They're here.' Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze flashing sharply. He deliberately wore a startled expression, his voice trembling as he shouted: 'You... Who are you people?' The two black-clad assassins exchanged a glance, and one of them sneered: 'The ones here to take your worthless life!' Blade light erupted, striking directly at Chen Ji's throat!

choice.prompt: The blade has arrived, your life hangs by a thread! When will Su Qingyao's ambush be launched?

choices.description: Let the blade edge approach another three cun, pretending to be in despair and awaiting death, then counterattack when the assassins are most smug and off guard, catching them completely off guard.
choices.visible_cost: Requires bearing the risk of minor injury
choices.visible_reward: The assassins' psychological defenses will collapse, making it easier to extract information
choices.risk_hint: If I mess up, I might actually get hurt.

dialogue.content: (A cold gleam flickers in his eyes) A little closer... a little closer...

choices.description: Break free from the disguise immediately, reveal my true strength, coordinate with Su Qingyao's ambush, and subdue the assassins as quickly as possible.
choices.visible_cost: May expose part of my strength.
choices.visible_reward: End the battle faster and reduce variables.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might notice something amiss.

dialogue.content: (His figure blurs) Since it's come to this, let's end this quickly!

text.content: The blade gleam was inches away, Chen Ji's pupils reflecting that piercing cold light. In that critical moment, his lips curved into a cold smirk. 'I've been waiting for you.' Before the words even finished, the pre-arranged formation blazed to life, countless sword lights shot out from all directions, engulfing the two assassins! At the same time, Su Qingyao's figure darted out like a startled swan, her sword sweeping across the sky, sword energy brilliant as a rainbow!

dialogue.content: (Coldly shouted) Shadow Moon Pavilion people? Bold indeed, daring to commit murder at the Tianqing Sect! (A flash of sword light drove back one assassin) Chen Ji, are you unharmed?

text.content: Chen Ji '狼狈' scrambled up from the ground, his face filled with terror as he hid behind Su Qingyao. The two assassins, trapped within the sword formation, their faces beneath the masks contorted in shock. They never imagined that a worthless servant disciple would have an ambush set by an Inner Sect Senior Fellow! One of them hissed: 'Su Qingyao, you've gone mad! Making an enemy of the Shadow Moon Pavilion for atrash?' The other gritted his teeth: 'Break through!' Both simultaneously channeled their spiritual energy, attempting to forcibly shatter the formation.

choice.prompt: The two assassins are desperately resisting. How do you plan to handle them?

choices.description: Subdue them and interrogate ruthlessly, extract the Second Elder's complete plan from their mouths to prepare for tomorrow's counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence and grasp the Second Elder's weakness.
choices.risk_hint: The interrogation process might be discovered.

dialogue.content: (Cold smirk) Survivors? Perfect. Let's see what price the Second Elder is willing to pay to ransom his dogs' lives.

choices.description: Kill one to warn a hundred, use their blood to tell the Second Elder that anyone who dares touch your people ends up in only one way—death!
choices.visible_reward: Deter the Second Elder, making him hesitate to act.
choices.risk_hint: Dead men tell no tales, the Second Elder may deny everything.

dialogue.content: (A killing intent flickers in his eyes) Only the dead can keep secrets. Since they wanted to kill me, don't blame me for being merciless.

text.content: Su Qingyao's sword light shifted, a fierce sword energy sweeping out, directly sending the assassin attempting to break through flying. Then, with a wave of her jade hand, a talisman shot out, transforming into chains that bound the two of them tightly. In moments, the two Foundation Building Late Stage assassins became captives. Su Qingyao clapped her hands, coldly looking at Chen Ji: 'trash, you're quite calculating. Go ahead, these twotrash are yours.' Her tone was icy cold, yet a probing gleam flickered in the depths of her eyes.

dialogue.content: (Crouching down and looking at the assassin still struggling, he said with a smile) Assassin from the Dark Moon Pavilion? How much did the Second Elder offer for my life? Fifty thousand spirit stones? Or a hundred thousand? Don't be nervous, I'm just curious. Since you won't be able to return tonight anyway, why not tell me what other plans the Second Elder has for tomorrow? Maybe if you please me, I might let you live.

text.content: The assassin glared fiercely at Chen Ji, grinding his teeth: "Wretch! Don't be smug! The Second Elder won't let you get away with this!" Hearing this, Chen Ji not only wasn't angry but actually laughed. He stood up, brushing the dust off his robe, his tone casual and unhurried: "Wretch? Perhaps. But it's this wretch who turned two 'masters' at the late Nascent Soul realm into stray dogs. When the Second Elder sent you, didn't he tell you that this wretch... is a bit unusual?"

The assassin's pupils constricted sharply, finally realizing that this 'wretch' was far from simple. His voice began to tremble: "Who... who exactly are you?" Chen Ji didn't answer, simply taking out a talisman from his sleeve, playing with it between his fingers. The talisman glowed with an eerie black light, obviously demonic path technique. "Who am I?" Chen Ji crouched down, pressing the talisman against the assassin's forehead, "I'm the kind of person the Second Elder fears most—the one who knows all his secrets. Speak, how does the Second Elder plan to deal with me at tomorrow's Sect Competition?"

The assassin shuddered violently, his face showing signs of internal struggle. But when the black light from the talisman began seeping into his Mental Sea, he finally broke down. "I'll talk! I'll talk!" he frantically shouted, "The Second Elder arranged for people to strike you during tomorrow's competition! As soon as you step onto the Arena, his men will kill you under the pretense of an 'accident'! Even if you don't compete, he'll bribe the judges to rule that you're cowardly, directly expelling you from the sect! It's a linked trap—no matter what you do, it's a dead end!"

After hearing this, a cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Second Elder's scheme was indeed vicious—he wanted to eliminate him publicly while also destroying his reputation. What a clever calculation. Beside him, Su Qingyao listened with an icy-cold expression, her voice heavy: "The Second Elder has gone mad! Actually daring to make a move during the competition!" But Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a hint of mockery: "Mad? No, he's far too confident. He thinks I'm just a wretch he can push around, but he doesn't know..." He paused, looking at the bound assassin, "Every move he makes, I see it clearly."

dialogue.content: (Frowning) Chen Ji, what are you planning to do? Since the Second Elder dares to make a move during the competition, he's definitely prepared backup plans. As a Foundation Building stage servant-disciple, you have no chance of victory in a direct confrontation.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, moonlight falling on his profile, reflecting a composure of strategic mastery. He didn't directly answer Su Qingyao's question but turned to look at the captured assassin, smiling meaningfully. "The Second Elder wants to kill me at the competition? Then I'll make him... drop a stone on his own foot in front of everyone." His voice wasn't loud, yet it carried a chilling intent that made one's heart tremble. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Kid, you've got big ambitions. But I like it."

Night wind blew past, dispersing the bloody smell around the spirit hall. The two assassins had been subdued, and tomorrow's competition conspiracy had surfaced. Chen Ji stood under the moonlight, gazing toward the Tianqing Sect Main Peak, his eyes flickering with profound light. The deadly trap the Second Elder had meticulously designed was nothing more than a controllable chess game in his eyes. He would make the Second Elder watch as his chess pieces betrayed him one by one, personally pushing him into an abyss from which there was no return. Turning the enemy's strategy against them, using their own methods against them—this was the game Chen Ji was most skilled at playing.
